package.description: AzaharPlus is a fork of the Azahar 3DS emulator that restores some features.

en-US.description: AzaharPlus is a fork of the Azahar 3DS emulator that restores some features.
en-US.longDescription: Each version is the same as the corresponding version of Azahar exept for these features: • Support of 3DS files. If a file works with earlier Citra forks, it works with AzaharPlus. • Ability to download system files from official servers. No need for an actual 3DS.
en-US.name: AzaharPlus
